acceptance_criteria.given: a Claude turn that streamed one assistant message whose usage reads 2 input + 333,000 cache-read + 100 cache-creation tokens
acceptance_criteria.then: its row is unavailable with estimated_input_tokens 333,102 and no measured tokens or cost

acceptance_criteria.given: a Claude turn that ends with its result
acceptance_criteria.then: its row is measured and carries no estimate
project.estimated_input_tokens is 333,102, budget.used_tokens 0, project.total_tokens null; the panel reads '≈333,102 input tokens, not measured — not counted against the budget'
acceptance_criteria.when: GET /accounting is read and the Budgets panel renders

design: Migration 0134_turn_usage_estimated_input_tokens: one nullable INTEGER column on turn_usage, plain ADD COLUMN guarded for a missing table and an existing column; nothing backfilled; downgrade drops the column. Revises 0133. Hazard: it reaches the operator's real database on their next :8000 restart.

checked: Acceptance test through the real trigger, a fake Claude PTY, the real stop route and GET /accounting

problem: A stopped Claude turn records its turn_usage row unavailable with no tokens and no cost, and the CLI's session totals never include the interrupted call, so F678's difference does not recover it either: about one model call is spent per Stop and appears nowhere (run-02af114595bf, sweep 2026-10-18). Only an estimate is possible: the interrupted call's input is at least the turn's last context reading.

requirements.rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-18: show the spend a Stop causes, marked as an estimate. The unavailable row's token columns are forbidden by ck_turn_usage_availability, and session_totals is F678's baseline, so the estimate has its own nullable column.
requirements.statement: When a Claude turn ends stopped and its accounting is unavailable, the Hub SHALL record on its turn_usage row an estimated input-token figure equal to that turn's last context reading (context_tokens of the last measured reading the run streamed), and SHALL record none when the turn streamed no reading, ended any other way, or was measured.

requirements.rationale: An estimate is a lower bound, not a measurement; counting it would let a guess pause autonomy.
requirements.statement: The accounting snapshot SHALL report each turn's estimate and the sum of the estimates of unavailable turns, per project and per agent, separately from every measured figure; the Budgets panel SHALL show it as '≈N input tokens, not measured' and say it is not counted against the budget; and the estimate SHALL NOT count toward the project's used tokens, its budget state, or any measured total.

non_goals: Recovering the interrupted call's exact cost or output tokens
Counting the estimate toward the budget

summary: A Claude turn the operator stops mid-call records an estimate of its interrupted call's input tokens on its unavailable accounting row; the estimate is shown as an estimate and counts toward nothing (F697).
title: A stopped turn's interrupted call is estimated, never counted
